The keyboards have white and black keys, with some having a blue or purple panel on the left side.
The keyboards appear to be of similar design, with a small display screen and control buttons on the right side.
The plastic wrapping is crinkled and shows signs of handling, suggesting they are new or recently unpacked.
No brand or model name is visible on any of the keyboards in any photo.
The background includes a wall with a fan and some boxes, possibly in a shop or storage area.
The watermark 'MARY OLUGBAMI POSTED ON JIJI' is present on all photos.
